evidence: A satisfying settlement can specify school CMS, monthly publication, no principal prepublication approval, a 5-day correction deadline, disabled comments, single-sign-on access, written guardian consent, a student_publication_protocol commitment, and justification/revelation of PF2. A plausible draft-based settlement would instead use weekly paper publication, principal prepublication approval, and no required consent, thereby failing multiple checks.
